test_name: AML rating review older than 12 months
description: Customers have not had their AML rating reviewed within the expected period.
governance_impact: Customer AML ratings may not reflect current risk profile or lifecycle changes.
recommended_action: Define rating review frequency by customer risk level and monitor overdue reviews.

test_name: High-risk factors with LOW/MEDIUM assigned AML rating
description: Customers with relevant AML risk factors were assigned a LOW or MEDIUM AML rating.
governance_impact: Potential misalignment between customer risk factors and corporate AML rating logic.
recommended_action: Review rating assignment rules, perform quality assurance and prioritise remediation for higher-risk customers.

test_name: Restrictive measures not reviewed within 12 months
description: Applied restrictive measures have not been reviewed within the expected period.
governance_impact: Restrictive measures may no longer reflect current risk or remediation status.
recommended_action: Define review cycles for restrictive measures and escalate overdue reviews.

description: Training initiatives have completion rates below 80%.
governance_impact: Weak adoption of AML lifecycle training may reduce effectiveness of transformation.
recommended_action: Monitor completion by geography and require action plans for low-completion areas.

test_name: Critical areas without completed AML lifecycle training
description: Critical areas have not completed AML lifecycle training.
governance_impact: AML lifecycle standards may not be understood by areas that execute customer processes.
recommended_action: Prioritise mandatory training completion for critical areas and track by business owner.

test_name: Active customers with expired KYC documentation
description: Active customers have expired KYC documentation.
governance_impact: Customer lifecycle documentation may not be refreshed in a timely manner.
recommended_action: Implement periodic KYC refresh monitoring and escalation for overdue documentation.

description: AML lifecycle communications have not been acknowledged by target areas.
governance_impact: Communication may not translate into confirmed awareness or ownership.
recommended_action: Track acknowledgement of AML communications and escalate overdue responses.

test_name: HIGH/CRITICAL customers without valid Source of Funds
description: High-risk customers do not have valid Source of Funds documentation.
governance_impact: Documentation requirements may not be aligned with the risk-based approach.
recommended_action: Prioritise remediation of Source of Funds gaps for HIGH and CRITICAL customers.

test_name: Legal entities without valid Beneficial Ownership documentation
description: Legal entity customers do not have valid beneficial ownership documentation.
governance_impact: Weakness in customer ownership transparency and KYC documentation standards.
recommended_action: Review beneficial ownership collection controls and remediation workflow for legal entities.

description: Customers with adverse media do not have enhanced monitoring activated.
governance_impact: Potential weakness in the link between adverse media indicators and ongoing monitoring.
recommended_action: Review adverse media escalation criteria and monitoring activation controls.

test_name: Critical AML reports overdue or not submitted
description: Critical AML lifecycle reports are overdue or not submitted.
key_dimension: Restrictive Measures: 3; Training & Communication: 2; AML Lifecycle Governance: 1
governance_impact: AML Holding may lack timely visibility over lifecycle risks and remediation status.
recommended_action: Escalate overdue reports and define ownership for report preparation and submission.

description: High-risk customers do not have restrictive or enhanced measures applied.
governance_impact: Risk-based measures may not be consistently triggered by AML rating.
recommended_action: Define automatic triggers for enhanced measures and review exceptions with Compliance owners.

test_name: AML lifecycle standard not fully implemented
description: Corporate AML lifecycle standards have not been implemented in all geographies.
governance_impact: Corporate AML standards may not be consistently deployed across geographies.
recommended_action: Track implementation status by geography and escalate delayed or not-started rollouts.

test_name: Open rollout gaps without closed remediation
description: Geographies have open rollout gaps that have not been fully remediated.
governance_impact: Rollout issues may remain unresolved after implementation or communication.
recommended_action: Monitor open gaps through governance reporting until remediation is closed.

description: Critical reports contain high-severity issues that have not been escalated.
governance_impact: Material AML lifecycle issues may not receive appropriate senior management attention.
recommended_action: Define escalation criteria for high-severity issues and monitor escalation completion.

description: Geographies have missed AML lifecycle rollout implementation deadlines.
governance_impact: Implementation delays may weaken consistency of AML lifecycle controls.
recommended_action: Assign remediation owners, update implementation plans and monitor overdue actions.
